_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
O sa qito Klondike Solitaire tiko. Na nomu icakacaka me move taki na kad kece ki na foundation piles.

Na lawa ni qito:
- Foundation piles (F1-F4): Build up taka na Ace ki na King ena suit
- Tableau piles (T1-T7): Build down taka na alternating colors (red ena black, black ena red)
- Stock: Draw taka na kad ki na waste pile
- Waste (W): Na kad sa tu ena top sa rawa me qito

Na veikomandi:
- 'draw' - Draw taka na kad taka na stock ki na waste
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Move taka na kad taka na piles
  I-tukutuku: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. Na count sa rawa me 'all', ka sa try me move taka na kad kece sa tu vakarau.
- 'forfeit' - Vakacava na qito tiko ga kei na nomu score sa tu kina
- Na yaca ni piles: W (waste), F1-F4 (foundations), T1-T7 (tableau)

O sa rawa me execute taka na actions kece ena turn e dua me veikataki ira na komata:
  I-tukutuku: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Na Kings wale ga sa rawa me tu ena tableau piles sa empty.
Na actions sa execute taka ena kena levu - kevaka e dua sa fail, na actions sa tu me baleta sa skip.
Vakayagataka 'forfeit' kevaka o sa nanuma na qito sa sega ni rawa me wini.

format_error.no_brackets: Na ivakarau e sega ni dodonu me tiko ena brackets.
format_error.no_closing_bracket: Na ivakarau ni cakacaka e sega ni dodonu. Sega na bracket ni icavacava ']'
format_error.empty_command: Vakarau ni veika vakaloloma. Volavola 'draw' se 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.move_needs_args: Na komandi 'move' e gadrevi me tiko kina e dua na ivakatakata kei na kena i tavi. Vakayagataki: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.count_positive: Na count sa gadreva me positive se 'all'
format_error.count_invalid: Na count sa sega ni dinau. Vakayagataka e dua na number se 'all'
format_error.unknown_command: Na komandi sa unknown '{cmd}'. Vakayagataka 'draw', 'move <source> <destination> [count]', se 'forfeit'

action_result.before_failure: Na cakacaka {n} sa vakayacori oti ni bera na druka.

move_result.drew: Sa draw taka na kad taka na stock ki na waste.
move_result.cannot_draw: E sega ni rawa na droini, sa lala kece tu.
move_result.invalid_pile: Na yaca ni iwiliwili e sega ni dodonu. Vakayagataka na W, F1-F4, se T1-T7
move_result.foundation_one_card: E rawa ni toso ga e 1 na kadi ki na yavu.
move_result.waste_to_foundation_ok: Na kadi e kau mai na benu ki na yavu F{dst}
move_result.waste_to_foundation_bad: Sega ni rawa me toso na kadi ni benu ki na yavu tudei oqori
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_ok: Kaciva na karo e tableau T{src} ki na foundation F{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_bad: Sega ni rawa me toso na kadi tableau ki na yavu tudei oqori
move_result.foundation_to_foundation: Sega ni rawa me toki mai na yavu ki na kena e dua tale.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_one_card: E rawa ni toso ga 1 na kadi mai na benu ki na tableau.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_ok: Na kadi e kau mai na benu ki na iyaloyalo T{dst}
move_result.waste_to_tableau_bad: E sega ni rawa me biu na kadi e yali ena i binibini tabolo oya.
move_result.no_face_up: Sega ni dua na kadi e laurai me toso tiko ga.
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_ok: Kaciva {count} karo(s) e tableau T{src} ki T{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_bad: E sega ni kacivi {count} karo(s) e T{src} ki T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_one_card: E rawa ni toso ga 1 na kadi mai na yavu ki tableau.
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_ok: Kaciva na karo e foundation F{src} ki na tableau T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_bad: Sega ni rawa me biu na kadi yavu ena teveli T{dst}
move_result.to_waste_or_stock: Sega ni rawa me biu ena benu se na iyaya e tu kina.

outcome.forfeit: Na qito e sa na sega ni rawa. icavacava: {score} kadi ena yavu.
outcome.won: Ni sa qaqa ena sotasota ni Klondike!
outcome.turn_limit: Na qito sa oti! O sa rawa na {max_turns} turns. Na nomu score sa tu kina: {score} kad sa tu ena foundations.
